# .specify/ — Spec Kit structure in this project

This folder follows the documented GitHub Spec Kit convention (`memory/constitution.md`, `templates/`, change specs in `specs/NNN-name/`).

**Important (ADR-0002):** this structure was **written by hand**, not generated by `specify init`, because the environment in which it was created had no access to the Spec Kit repository. Before using the `/speckit.*` commands for the first time:

1. Pin a version and run `specify init --here --integration claude` **on a copy** of the project.
2. Compare the result with this folder; preserve `memory/constitution.md` and the template adaptations (`REQ-<CAP>-NN` IDs, "Delta in the living spec", REQ column in the tasks).
3. Record the version and the differences in ADR-0002.

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `memory/constitution.md` | Constitution (single source; read by `/speckit.plan` in the "Constitution Check") |
| `templates/spec-template.md` | Skeleton of `specs/NNN-*/spec.md` |
| `templates/plan-template.md` | Skeleton of `plan.md` (with the Constitution Check) |
| `templates/tasks-template.md` | Skeleton of `tasks.md` (each task links to a REQ and a test) |
